Using Reflex Hub means you understand and accept the terms below. This site is a free tool and public-information compilation; it provides no legal, procurement or investment advice. Last updated: 2026-10-28.

· Content is informational and computational assistance; it does not constitute legal advice, procurement advice, investment advice, or any evaluation of model quality.

2. Prices, exchange rates and estimates

· Cost estimates rely on fixed assumptions and exclude free tiers, resource packs, subscription discounts and limited-time promotions; an estimate is not a provider's actual invoice. For production or commercial procurement, rely on the provider's formal quotes, contracts and terms.
